newsitem.title: USA: FTC probing Philip Morris - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FTC probing Philip Morris - WSJ.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc's method of distributing its cigarettes is being investigated by the Federal Trade Commission, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the tobacco giant made a terse reference to the investigation in a filing it submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Philip Morris said in the filing that it had been told the FTC was investigating the company's "merchandising practices at the wholesale and retail levels" to determine if it unfairly restricts the distribution of competing brands.
A spokesman for Philip Morris did not immediately return a telephone call from Reuters early Thursday morning.
But the Journal quoted a company spokeswoman as saying the FTC probe was a "preliminary inquiry," and that the company "believes it has acted lawfully."
An unidentified lawyer familiar with the investigation told the Journal that no action appeared imminent against Philip Morris.
Philip Morris sells Marlboro, as well as Virginia Slims and Merit brands.
